<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:3:8">Y. Snh. II, 20ᵇ</cite> top (expl. <cite ref="L00343"><he>לחי</he></cite>, <cite ref="I Samuel 25:61">I Sam. XXV, 61</cite>) <he>לק׳</he> (so may it be) for life; Midr. Sam. ch. XXIII <he>לקיומו</he> (corr. acc.).
Koh. R. to VI, 3, v. יְקוּם; Gen. R. s. 32 קִיּוּמַיָּה (pl.) living beings; Yalk. ib. 56.

Y. Ḥag. III, 79ᵇ top מתניתא מינה קִיּוּמָהּ וכ׳ from the Mishnah we can derive the confirmation of this opinion and also its refutation. M. Mets. 20ᵇ לא משהי אינש קִיּוּמֵיה וכ׳ no man leaves a certified document of his with the scribe; (Ms. M. a. oth. קִיּוּמֵי pl.).
